messages:
maria: heads-up — i'm starting the handoff of zeta-13b v2 weights from HF to the internal artifact registry. need a quick checklist: owner, ACL, checksum verification, and tokenizer sanity. who can own the registry entry?

kevin: i can take ownership for the registry side. do we want public-read or org-only?

maria: org-only (redwood-internal). also will enable signed presign URLs for deploys.

ash: quick note on the tokenizer — HF's repo has two tokenizer files, `tokenizer.json` and `tokenizer_config.json`. last time we saw subtle BOS id mismatches when both were present. can we run the tokenizer smoke test after import?

maria: good catch. plan: mirror weights + sharded ckpt -> registry path, then run `tools/tokenizer-smoke.sh` against the registry manifest. if that succeeds we mark ready-for-serving.

kevin: what's the exact registry path you plan to use? i need it to set ACLs.

maria: using `s3://redwood-artifacts/managed-models/zeta/13B/v2/weights/` and registry manifest at `s3://redwood-artifacts/managed-models/zeta/13B/v2/manifest.json`. will also add `origin: hf://huggingface/zeta-13b` in metadata.

ash: can you paste the presign command you plan to use for the CI deploys?

maria: sure — presign generation (short TTL) from the registry account:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-artifacts/managed-models/zeta/13B/v2/weights/part-0000.ckpt --expires-in 300
# we wrap this in the artifact service which embeds signed headers in the deploy manifest
```

kevin: ACLs set to org-only, bucket policy will deny public GETs. i'll add artifact-bot as reader so the deploy CI can fetch.

artifact-bot: checksum-scan started for manifest.json (sha256). 0/6 files processed.

maria: running checksum locally then uploading manifest with checksums. will include `sha256` and file sizes in manifest.

ash: after the tokenizer smoke, i'll run a short generate test with `seq_len=512` and compare tokenization between HF org repo and our mirrored files. ping me when checkpoint upload is complete.

kevin: added `artifact-reader` role to `artifact-bot` and `deploy-ci` in IAM. also added alert if any file has mismatched size/checksum. :thumbsup:

maria: upload complete, manifest pushed. checksum results: all 6 blobs match sha256. running tokenizer-smoke now.

artifact-bot: checksum-scan complete — all blobs verified.

ash: tokenizer smoke passed but noticed `unk_token` mapping differs (HF: `<unk>`, our default: `<unk>` but ids shifted by +1). quick patch to tokenizer config needed. i'll open a tiny PR to normalize special token ids.

maria: thanks — once the PR lands i'll update manifest `tokenizer_version` and re-run smoke. can we keep serving on a canary pool until final validation?

kevin: yes, create a canary route (zeta-13b-v2-canary) pinned to the mirrored weights with a strict timeout. i'll configure fallback to zeta-13b-v1 if any errors spike.

maria: sounds good. timeline: PR in ~20m, re-run tests, then promote to canary. if all green, we can schedule a gradual rollout tomorrow.

sophie: fyi — logs for the upload live at `ci.redwood/artifacts/1815/zeta-upload.log` if anyone needs them.

maria: awesome. thanks everyone. i'll post a short status when canary is up. :sparkles:
